subset_rule.basis: Deterministic coverage sample from the frozen FIT and VALIDATION partitions only
subset_rule.selection: All Track-A FIT and VALIDATION units whose condition_labels include scanned, broken_text, vector_text, legacy_font_candidate, or native_clean_control

double_annotation.rule: Every unit whose deterministic SHA-256 rank begins with hexadecimal 0, 1, 2, or 3

adjudication.trigger: annotator route disagreement or either confidence below HIGH
adjudication.adjudicator: third human annotator blind to engine outputs
adjudication.allowed_evidence: rendered page image plus the written route protocol
adjudication.result: single adjudicated gold_route with retained original annotations

downstream_identity_rule: Everything after routing, including recovery adapter version and all ARPipe downstream stages, is identical between ACTUAL_ROUTING and ORACLE_ROUTING.
primary_contribution_metric: paired page_span_iou difference ORACLE_ROUTING minus ACTUAL_ROUTING with issuer-clustered 95% bootstrap CI
interpretation_limit: Routing contribution is an experimental contrast, not a causal claim outside this design.
